下载网站文件、配置、数据库及证书材料的完整备份，包含网站私钥和根证书私钥。: Download a complete backup of website files, configuration, database and certificates, including website and root CA private keys.
修改 Nginx 全局配置，对所有网站生效；网站高级配置中显式设置的同名指令优先: Edit global Nginx settings for all websites. Explicit directives in a website's advanced configuration take precedence.
压缩级别，1～9；越高消耗的 CPU 越多: Compression level, 1–9; higher levels use more CPU
同一端口内域名不能重复，不同端口可以复用域名或 IP；填写 0.0.0.0 可接: Domains must be unique on the same port. Reuse domains or IPs on different ports, or enter 0.0.0.0 to match any domain on that port. The code is unique on the node and cannot be changed after creation.
同时永久删除网站目录及文件: Also permanently delete the website directory and files
启用响应压缩；压缩类型遵循 Nginx 默认规则和网站配置。: Compress responses using Nginx default MIME types and website settings.
在文件管理中上传文件或目录。当前运行目录中的文件修改直接生效；修改运行目录后点击: Upload files or directories in File Manager. Changes inside the current document root apply immediately. After changing the document root, click Save and reload.
在文件管理中打开网站目录: Open website directory in File Manager
域名哈希桶大小（字节），32～65536，必须为 2 的幂: Domain hash bucket size (bytes), 32–65536; must be a power of two
实际有效期不超过所选根证书的到期时间。: Validity is capped at the selected root certificate's expiration.
最小压缩响应（字节），1024 字节 = 1 KB，最大 1073741824: Minimum response size for compression (bytes), 1024 bytes = 1 KB, maximum 1073741824
每行一项，支持通配域名、IPv4 和 IPv6: One per line; wildcard domains, IPv4 and IPv6 supported
确认删除 {name}？仍被网站引用的证书不能删除。: Delete {name}? Certificates still used by websites cannot be deleted.
空闲连接超时（秒），0 表示禁用长连接，最大 86400: Idle connection timeout (seconds), 0 to disable keep-alive, maximum 86400
网站证书已签发，可在网站配置中选择: Certificate issued; select it in website settings
请从 Veydeck 控制台打开网站管理，以使用文件管理应用: Open Website Manager from the Veydeck console to use File Manager.
请填写域名或 IP: Enter a domain or IP address
请求体大小上限（MB），0 表示不限制，最大 1048576: Request body limit (MB), 0 for unlimited, maximum 1048576
选择根证书即可签发网站证书；客户端安装并信任相应根证书后，才能信任其签发的网站证: Select a root to issue website certificates. Clients must install and trust that root to trust the issued certificates.
默认仅监听 IPv4；开启后同时监听 [::]:{port}。: IPv4 only by default. Enable to also listen on [::]:{port}.
默认使用第一个域名，可自行修改: Defaults to the first domain; editable
